title: Pi catalog and RuntimeAdapter
objective: Expose Pi through the same model-catalog and Run-scoped execution behavior as OpenCode while keeping Pi-specific lifecycle details behind its adapter.
requirements: Pi catalog discovery returns only authenticated, exact provider/model identities from the pinned SDK and fails closed when discovery is unavailable or the selected model is absent.

Pi variants expose only SDK-supported thinking levels as stable identifiers, preserve the existing exact-match and single-variant fallback rules, and reject unsupported or clamped selections before Run creation.
PiRuntimeLive implements RuntimeAdapter by combining selected-only isolation, one child worker per Job, and the shared disposable Agent workspace boundary.
Pi execution rejects non-Pi Jobs, SDK-version mismatch, worker-protocol mismatch, unavailable model, and unsupported variant before agent-input admission or child spawn.
Pi lifecycle facts map to the same sanitized attempt observations, adapter failure categories, target evidence, and candidate shape used by OpenCode.

Deterministic catalog and adapter tests prove create/replace parity, frozen context availability, disposable auxiliary mutations, target-only extraction, typed failures, pre-admission validation, cleanup, sibling independence, and concurrent one-process-per-Job behavior without paid calls.

skills.name: Truthful Pi catalog
skills.content: Use the pinned SDK's ModelRuntime with Pi auth/models paths and a bounded timeout. Include only models for which an effective credential is available. Sort by stable providerId/modelId. Derive variant IDs only from thinking levels the exact model advertises; if Pi would clamp a level, do not advertise it and reject it explicitly. Reuse RuntimeAdapterCatalog semantics and AdapterCatalogDiscoveryError. Never choose a model or variant implicitly when more than one is available.

constraints: Do not create a Run, Job, session, or child process during discovery.
Do not expose credentials, auth paths, or raw SDK errors.
Do not query package latest-version services.

skills.name: Thin concrete adapter
skills.content: At withRun entry, validate every frozen Pi configuration against the implementation pins and catalog. For each Job, create selected-only isolation, create one PiWorkerRequest, and supply an AgentWorkspaceInvoke that starts one makePiWorkerInvoke child. Let invokeInAgentWorkspace own target and context seeding, target-only candidate production, evidence, discard, and cleanup. Send only the lean Agent Input to the child. Map worker lifecycle facts through RuntimeAttemptReporter using the same stable phases as OpenCode. Keep provider/SDK details private.

constraints: Reject `job.adapter.kind !== "pi"` and any version mismatch before isolation, child spawn, or admission.
Do not reuse child processes or Pi sessions across Jobs.
Do not duplicate workspace inspection or candidate logic.

skills.name: Cross-adapter parity tests
skills.content: Drive RuntimeAdapter with a fake Pi catalog and worker gateway. Cover nested create and replace, frozen context availability, context and scratch mutations being discarded, only the assigned target returned, missing and unchanged output, provider/tool/timeout/interruption/protocol/cleanup failures, admitted target evidence, observations, selected-only isolation cleanup, OpenCode Job rejection, both version mismatches, absent model, unsupported variant, sibling independence, and concurrent invocations proving distinct process/session identifiers.
